battlefield.gauntlet: Six Territory Cards arranged in one column.
battlefield.starting_position: Each Player Token begins on the Territory at that player's own end of the Gauntlet. Setup placement is not movement and does not count as entering.
battlefield.capture: During Capture, if your token is on or beyond the next opposing Territory immediately beyond your Front Line, add that Territory to your Front Line. Normal Capture advances the Front Line by at most one Territory per turn. Capturing the Territory at the opponent's end immediately runs the Gauntlet and wins.
battlefield.victory: Run the Gauntlet and win immediately by either capturing the Territory at the opponent's end or winning the opponent's Last Stand.

last_stand.text: The defender normally has Defensive Edge and separately adds +1 to their battle total.
last_stand.access: After the opponent is forced beyond their own end, an attacker on the opponent's final Territory may initiate the Last Stand by using a separate legal movement sequence to Advance beyond that end.

battlefield.front_line: The unbroken sequence of Territories a player controls from their own end. Control cannot skip an opposing Territory, although a Player Token may move beyond its Front Line.

battle.defensive_edge: When the defender has Defensive Edge, the defender wins tied battle totals. The defender normally has it while controlling the contested Territory or making a Last Stand, unless an effect removes it.
battle.tiebreak_roll: Each player rolls one die. Do not apply advantage, disadvantage, card effects, numerical modifiers, or previous battle totals. Higher roll wins; reroll further ties.
battle.withdrawal: Withdrawal during Onset ends the battle sequence without a winner or battle result. No Gambits are set and no Aftermath occurs. After Onset has completed and the battle has proceeded to Gambits, a later withdrawal completes the remaining non-result Aftermath steps and clears committed battle cards normally.
battle.retreat: A losing player retreats. Retreat follows a battle result and applies normal win, loss, Occupation, and result effects.
battle.onset: When movement initiates a battle, enter Onset. Establish the attacker, defender, contested Position, and attacker's previous Position. Resolve Terms first when applicable. If the battle is prevented or a player withdraws during Onset, end the battle sequence without setting Gambits and without a battle result. Otherwise resolve other effects that apply during Onset or before Gambits are set, then proceed to Gambits.
onset_steps: Establish the attacker, defender, contested Position, and attacker's previous Position.
If the battle has been prevented or a player withdraws, end the battle sequence.
Resolve other effects that apply during Onset or before Gambits are set.
If the battle still proceeds, continue to Gambits.
battle.battle_fought: A battle sequence that ends during Onset is not a battle fought, won, or lost. Once Onset completes and the sequence proceeds to Gambits, the battle has proceeded for effects that care whether a battle occurred.
battle.movement: Entering the opponent's Position initiates a battle and ends that movement sequence. Effects that grant movement may initiate a battle unless they say otherwise.
battle.terms: Terms are resolved during Onset after the attacker, defender, contested Position, and attacker's previous Position are established, and before other pre-Gambit effects. The attacker has the first opportunity to offer Terms. If the attacker passes, the defender may offer. Once either player offers Terms, the other cannot offer Terms in that battle sequence even if the Proposal is refused. Accepted Terms end the battle sequence during Onset. Refused Terms apply their Refused effect and any refusal modifiers, then Onset continues unless that effect ends the sequence.

general_rule.heading: Arcane symbol
general_rule.placement: Part I > Chapter 2 > Printed card effects
general_rule.body: Arcane cards are marked with the Mystics sigil. The sigil is shown in the card's faction color, or the Neutral color on Neutral cards. The symbol's shape identifies the Arcane trait; its color reflects the card's allegiance.

mystics_rule.heading: Arcane trait
mystics_rule.placement: Part III > Mystics > Mystics-specific rules > Arcane trait
mystics_rule.body: Arcane is a trait, not faction allegiance. Mystics cards are Arcane, and cards from other pools may also have the trait. Arcane cards are marked with the Mystics sigil, shown in the card's faction color or the Neutral color on Neutral cards. The symbol's shape identifies the Arcane trait; its color reflects the card's allegiance.

factionFeatureTaxonomy.factionFeature: A named faction-specific mechanic shared by the faction. A Faction Feature may have multiple uses, modes, or procedures; those are described under the feature rather than treated as separate Features.
factionFeatureTaxonomy.leaderAbility: A mechanic or option supplied specifically by the chosen Leader rather than shared by the faction. A Leader Ability may provide a specific option used through a shared Faction Feature, such as an individual Military Order.

actionProfiles.1 Action: Using the Feature or Ability spends one Action at its stated legal phase or timing.
actionProfiles.No Action: Use at the stated timing without spending an Action. This does not grant another Action.
actionProfiles.Automatic: Apply automatically when its stated condition and timing occur; no Action is spent.

rites.name: Rite of Echoes
rites.begin: Bind one card from your Graveyard face up beneath this Rite. Then bind one card from your Hand face up beneath it that shares its title with at least one card in your Draw Pile. Search your Draw Pile for that card, reveal it, shuffle your Draw Pile, then place the revealed card on top.
rites.complete: On a later turn, complete this Rite after you win a battle in which the Gambit or Tactic effect of a card with the bound Hand card's title was applied. Move the card bound from your Graveyard to your Discard Pile. Put the card bound from your Hand in your Graveyard.
rites.interrupted: If you lose a battle before completion, put both bound cards in your Graveyard and reset this Rite.

rites.name: Rite of Blood
rites.begin: Put one card from your Hand in your Graveyard.
rites.complete: On a later turn, complete this Rite when you win a battle without setting a Gambit or choosing a Tactic.

reminder.text: Using Transmutation, an Asset, Overlay, Territory effect, Leader Ability, or card from another source does not by itself prevent completion.

rites.interrupted: If you lose a battle before completion, reset this Rite.

rites.name: Rite of Crossing
rites.begin: You may begin this Rite during Denouement only after winning a battle that turn that made you the occupier of a Territory the opponent controlled immediately before that battle.
rites.complete: At the start of your next turn, after the Capture step, complete this Rite if you are still the occupier or now control that Territory.
rites.interrupted: If before then you cease to occupy that Territory, reset this Rite.

rites.name: Rite of Shattering
rites.begin: Put one banked Asset in your Graveyard.
rites.complete: In the first battle that reaches dice on a later turn, gain a number of instances of advantage equal to that Asset's value. If you win that battle, complete this Rite.
rites.interrupted: If you lose that battle, Retreat +1 and reset this Rite.

rites.name: Rite of Consecration
rites.begin: Place one Overlay from Hand on a Territory without using an Action. That Territory is consecrated while this Rite is active.
rites.complete: On a later turn, complete this Rite after you win a battle on the consecrated Territory.
rites.interrupted: If you lose a battle on the consecrated Territory before completion, or if that Overlay is removed from the Territory before completion, reset this Rite.

rites.name: Rite of Equivalence
rites.begin: Choose one card in your Hand and one card in your Graveyard with the same value. Exchange them. Keep the card moved to your Hand revealed while this Rite is active.
rites.complete: Complete when you play the exchanged card for one of its printed effects.
rites.interrupted: If the exchanged card leaves your Hand in any other way, or if you lose a battle before completion, reset this Rite.

ritual.name: Ritual of Ascension
ritual.begin: After completing all three selected Rites, during Denouement, spend 1 Action to bind one Arcane card from your Hand, one Arcane card from your Discard Pile, and one Arcane card from your Graveyard. This begins the Ritual.
ritual.convergence: While the Ritual is underway, during a battle you initiated, add +1 to your battle total for each card bound to the Ritual.
ritual.complete: Initiate a battle while all three Ritual cards remain bound. If you win that battle, complete the Ritual and immediately win the game.
ritual.interrupted: If you lose any battle before Ritual completion, the Ritual is interrupted. Put all three Ritual-bound cards in your Graveyard. Withdrawal neither completes nor interrupts the Ritual.

selectionPolicy.rule: Choose exactly three different Rites from the six-Rite pool as part of the Mystics game package. You are under no obligation to reveal them until you begin them. When you begin a Rite, reveal it. Only those selected Rites may be begun during that game. Completing all three selected Rites satisfies the three-Rite requirement for the Ritual route.

generalRules.impossibleCompletion: If an active Rite can no longer be completed because a required card, component, position, or game state is lost or changes, it is immediately interrupted and resets.
